news_trading: Restricted: High Stakes forbids new orders 2 minutes before/after high-impact news; bracketing pending orders around high-impact news is prohibited in all programs (T&C)
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: T&C require prior written approval for automated trading software; third-party EAs, rollover-scalping EAs, HFT, tick scalping and arbitrage are prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: copy trading or trade coordination with other traders/accounts is prohibited (T&C)
overnight_weekend_holding: Overnight and weekend holding allowed; indices held over the weekend carry high swap. Futures Day Trade accounts must close 10 minutes before market close; futures Swing accounts cannot hold over the weekend.
restricted_countries_note: Forbidden Territories include Afghanistan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina (in T&C), Cuba, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Lebanon, Russia, Syria, Venezuela, Yemen and others. T&C: MetaQuotes platforms (MT5) may not be used by US residents. List: https://the5ers.com/terms-and-conditions/
payout_methods: Crypto: USDT TRC20, USDC ERC20, ETH, LTC (3.5% fee, $1,500 cap per withdrawal)

affiliate_program.notes: Refer-a-trader program exists; commission rates not published on the page. Sign-up via https://hub.the5ers.com/affiliate
